notes.title: New Update to AO International Tennis now available
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

The Australian Open is now underway and to celebrate it, we are pleased to announce a new update for AO International Tennis!

Patch notes are as follows,

Added Margaret Court Arena.
Added Pat Rafter Stadium.
Added official 2019 Australian Open stadium sponsors.
Improvements to player movement.
Improvements to AI match logic.
Improvements to AI Drop Shot behaviour.
Aggressiveness of AI tuned.
Added Ball physics to umpire chair.
Rectified PlayFace download issues.
Rectified Erroneous umpire calls.
Rectified Doubles selection playing singles matches.
Rectified Net Collison issues.
Rectified Cut Scene camera in crowd.
Rectified Reverse shot issues.
Rectified Career player ranking order issues.
Rectified Career night match issues.
Rectified viewing history of a match in career issues.
General Stability improvements.


Thanks to everyone for playing AO International Tennis and for sending us your valuable feedback!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Big New Update for AO International Tennis
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

A big new update just went live for AO International Tennis.

Update notes are as follows:

[list][*]Improvements to ball trajectories.
[*]Improvements to skill differentiation.
[*]Improvements to stamina drain.
[*]Improvements to Net Aggressiveness based on court surface.
[*]Improvements to AI fault and double fault percentages and improved situational awareness.
[*]Improvements to doubles, tactics applied by AI.
[*]Improvements to clay court texture and foot print marks.
[*]Added preferred and least preferred court type to identity, appropriately decreasing or boosting skills and attributes.
[*]Added ability to change net aggression and preferred court type at the end of year in career.
[*]Added AI Stamina Indicator option to settings.
[*]Added option to enable or disable Stamina in gameplay modifiers.
[*]Added new clay and grass court colours to venue creator.
[*]Added ability global stadium colours setting to stadiums in venue creator.
[*]Added toggleable stadium labels to venue creator.
[*]Added additional filters to venue list menu.
[*]Added ability to search by country for venues in community.
[*]Added ability to search for PlayFace only players in community.
[*]Added ability to search by Gender in community.
[*]Added regionally generated player names in career.
[*]Added daytime to career matches.
[*]Added minimum stamina drop of 10% per set based on player rating.
[*]Location of Big Ant Championship career tournament set to London, England.
[*]Improved loading screens.[/list]

Enjoy!
